design_philosophy: Actionable, Search-First, Data-Dense. The tool must prioritize high legibility for technical data (APIs, MongoDB, test steps). Minimize cognitive load using progressive disclosure and a modular 'Control Room' grid.

key_components.name: Sidebar Navigation
key_components.rules: Collapsible left sidebar. Include Search (Cmd+K) at the very top. Highlight active state with a bold left border (primary color) and subtle background tint.

key_components.name: Global Search / Command Palette
key_components.rules: Highly visible on every page. Use a large search bar that opens a Cmd+K dialog. Include autosuggest and category filters.

key_components.name: Data Tables
key_components.rules: Use Shadcn Table. Monospaced font for API endpoints, Redis Keys, and MongoDB collections. Use badges for HTTP methods (GET = Blue, POST = Green, DELETE = Red).

key_components.name: AI Chat Agent Panel
key_components.rules: Slide-over (Sheet component) on the right side. Distinguishable from main content via a subtle off-white background (#FAFAFA) and a persistent input area at the bottom.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. Code blocks must have high-contrast themes.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case format (e.g., `data-testid="feature-search-input"`).

login_background.description: Abstract white geometric hexagonal background to be used subtly on the login screen.

mock_avatar_1.description: Professional avatar for activity feed or contributor list

mock_avatar_2.description: Professional avatar for activity feed or contributor list

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with 'Chivo' (headings), 'IBM Plex Sans' (body), and 'JetBrains Mono' (code).
Ensure all Shadcn components are created using .js (not .tsx) and integrate data-testid attributes seamlessly.
Use Lucide React or Phosphor Icons for interface actions.
The AI Agent panel should slide over the content (Sheet component) rather than taking up permanent screen real estate.
Data tables for APIs, Test Steps, and Mocking must be highly dense and readable, avoiding excessive padding.
